text: The Sharma family moves into a suburban house rumoured to be haunted, and a stray cat with a vacant stare found in the basement is [crushed under Mr. Sharma's reversing car|trigger|a sudden accident or attack]. Soon their daughter Mini turns on her boyfriend with reddening eyes like the cat's, and a classmate dies with her neck snapped backwards while Mini [twists the head of her doll|images|dolls, masks and likenesses]. An exorcist finds [the ghost of a murdered mistress beneath the floorboards|origin|the wronged dead return], and she [takes hold of Mini|threat|being taken over].
